subject: Zenith onboarding workshop — access, shipping & calendar holds
messages:
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenithsys.com>, Ops Logistics <ops@zenithsys.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenith onboarding workshop — proposed dates and asks

Hi Elena / Ops team,

Thanks again for the visibility — we’re excited to run the two-day onboarding workshop + executive sync for Zenith. To get planning moving, can you hold the following dates locally? We’ll be hybrid but want on-site AV + secure room for executive breakout sessions.

- Oct 26 (Mon): Full-day onboarding (engineering + product breakouts)
- Oct 27 (Tue): Executive sync + customer business review (AM), open office hours (PM)
- Oct 25 (Sun) afternoon: AV rehearsal and hardware arrival window (team will be onsite to test)

Logistics asks:
- Confirm a secure room for execs with capacity for 12 and an adjacent war room for engineers (networked, wired Ethernet preferred)
- Visitor badge process and a single point of contact on-site for badge pickup
- Shipping address and any customs/formalities for bringing in demo hardware (we’ll ship 3 evaluation appliances)
- Hotel block recommendation and a link for attendee booking

We’ve tentatively blocked these dates on our side; I’ll share calendar invites and the mutual action plan once you confirm the window.

Thanks — cc’ing Karthik for logistics and Marcus for AV support.

— Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment: shipping_manifest_template.xlsx (template for customs/shipment details)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenithsys.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops Logistics <ops@zenithsys.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 17:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Zenith onboarding workshop — proposed dates and asks

Hi Monica — thanks, this looks great. We’re keen to proceed. A couple quick notes from our side:

- The Milan HQ can host Oct 26–27 as proposed, but our on-site AV vendor is only available for rehearsal on Oct 24 (Sunday) rather than Oct 25. Can you confirm if your team can move the rehearsal to Oct 24 afternoon?
- For hardware: customs in Italy typically needs final paperwork 7 business days before arrival. Thomas (cc’d) will coordinate with our facilities team on which port to use and whether temporary import is needed.
- Hotel: we can get a rate at the Ambasciatori Hotel (link below) but need a rooming list and cut-off date.

Thomas — are you able to coordinate on local vendor access and loading-dock times?

Cheers,
Elena
Head of Partnerships, Zenith Systems
Elena.Rossi@zenithsys.com

Related: Ambasciatori Hotel booking link (sent separately)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenithsys.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops Logistics <ops@zenithsys.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenith onboarding workshop — shipping & hotel logistics

Elena / team — quick logistics items and deadlines from our ops side: 

- If rehearsal moves to Oct 24, earliest arrival for the appliances should be Oct 23 (local delivery) to allow 24th testing. For customs: please provide the importer of record and commercial invoice by Oct 15 to avoid delays.
- Shipping manifest template attached — please fill out columns A–F and return to our ops team.
- Hotel block: suggested block at Ambasciatori — I’ve included hotel_block_info.pdf with the negotiated nightly rate and cut-off (Oct 8). Please confirm names and room types by Oct 8 to lock the rate.
- Parking & loading: Milan HQ requires a loading-dock reservation; Ops, please share available 1-hour slots between 08:00–12:00 on Oct 23.

Attachments: shipping_manifest_template.xlsx, hotel_block_info.pdf

We’ll also prepare an ICS invite for the rehearsal and the two workshop days. Marcus will own AV checklist and cable list.

— Karthik
Logistics & Program Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenithsys.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops Logistics <ops@zenithsys.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenith onboarding workshop — calendar holds and MAP

Thanks all — we’ll shift rehearsal to Oct 24 per Elena’s availability. I’ve attached the calendar ICS for the three holds (rehearsal + two workshop days) and shared the mutual action plan doc for edits: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c4d-mutual-action-plan

Next actions:
- Elena / Ops: confirm importer of record + preliminary rooming list by Oct 8 (Karthik)
- Thomas: confirm loading-dock 1-hour slot (Oct 23) by EOD Sept 30 if possible
- Marcus: AV checklist + equipment list to be sent by Oct 5
- Monica: finalize attendee list and logistics invites by Oct 1

Attachment: workshop_calendar.ics

Monica
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Ops Logistics <ops@zenithsys.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenithsys.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:18:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Zenith onboarding workshop — loading, badges, floorplan

Hi all — confirmed items from facilities: 

- Loading-dock slot: Oct 23, 09:00–10:00 local time reserved. Please bring a printed manifest for check-in.
- Visitor badge process: AV vendor and Redwood staff will meet security on arrival; badges issued at the lobby after ID check. Please send a final attendee list 24 hours prior.
- Room confirmed: Exec room (Room B12) capacity 12, adjacent war room (Room B14) reserved.
- Attached: tentative_floorplan.png with marked entrances and dock route.

Ops will follow up with the on-site AV vendor contact and a local phone number by Oct 10.

— Milan Facilities (Ops Logistics)

Subject: Re: Zenith onboarding workshop — headcount & travel windows

Quick internal note — finalizing travel for our staff:

- Marcus and I will arrive Oct 22 (window open Oct 22–24 for rehearsal prep)
- Karthik will support shipments arriving Oct 23 morning
- I’ll own hotel rooming list consolidation — Monica, can you confirm if we need an extra night for the execs (Oct 27 -> Oct 28) in case of late departures?

Monica: can you ask Elena to confirm final attendee list and any dietary restrictions by Oct 1 so I can submit the rooming names to the hotel?
